# WP MCP Server

> Self-hosted WordPress tools for AI clients: preview edits, preserve explicit scoped requirements, and retain change history.

Core is MIT licensed. Correction rules are explicitly configured and apply to supported edits. Browser verification is separate. Cloud is arranged early access, with no self-service checkout or automatic trial.
